title: DECA - DOCOL Register Adapter
author: marcos.rds
description:
**Adapter and extender for register trim, converting Docol stem Ø9.2 mm with 20 splines to DECA standard Ø13 mm with 18 splines**

This model was created to solve the incompatibility between the register's shaft/stem and the trim, and also functions as an extender, helping in situations where the original stem is too recessed in the wall

The part was **modeled in FreeCAD**, a **parametric** CAD software, and I am also providing the **.FCStd file**, so that each person can easily change length, number of splines, diameters, and other measurements according to their application's needs

I printed this part in **PLA**, with **100% infill**, to improve strength. Still, I **strongly recommend printing in PETG**, as it offers better mechanical resistance and greater durability for this type of use, since the part operates under torque

In my case, the application is for a **gate valve register**, which will be **used infrequently**, only for maintenance situations. For this use case, the part **worked and served very well**

This result was obtained **after some tests and dimensional adjustment attempts**, until a satisfactory fit was achieved. Therefore, it is important to remember that small variations may exist between manufacturers, lines, and even between parts of the same application

**Model Specifications:**

- Female input: **Docol Ø9.2 mm – 20 splines**
- Male output: **DECA Ø13 mm – 18 splines**
- Function: **adapter + extender**

**Important:**

Before printing, check the measurements of your register and trim. Since the parametric **.FCStd** file is included, any adjustments to length, number of splines, and diameters can be easily made to adapt the model to your needs
